question: Congratulations on Season 3 of the anime! Is there anything in particular that's important to you when it comes to the anime adaptation?
answer:
Basically, I recognize that the anime is the work of the directors and staff who create it.

What I write is simply the original novel, so when it comes to things like how scenes are expressed or how lines are handled in the anime, I follow the rules of the anime.

That said, there are fundamental things I'll point out, such as, “Please make sure this doesn't deviate from the intended meaning.”

Beyond that, I want to leave it to the staff to make the anime better and more enjoyable, so I generally try not to interfere too much.

What's important to me is getting along well with the staff.

I bring snacks to the recording sessions every week! (laughs)
